guard: a broker-refused endpoint publish is surfaced immediately as permission-denied, while an admitted request with no responder remains an unanswered availability failure
why: THE DEFECT LIVES BETWEEN THE GRANT ARRAY AND THE BROKER. The first suite signs the historical
spawn profile through the ordinary account chain and publishes the exact manager.inspect subject
to a self-owned JWT broker. It also mints the current spawn profile and a capability-less profile
as the positive and negative controls.
THE SURFACING HALF IS SEPARATE. The transport reports a refused core publish asynchronously on
nc.status(); without the subject-scoped watch epCall waits out the reply budget and stamps
EP_UNANSWERED. Mutation 1 removes that watch and must fail on the named permission-denied cell.
THE CONNECTOR MUST NOT RE-COLLAPSE THE DISTINCTION. Mutation 2 restores the old two-cause sentence
for actual silence. The verdict smoke requires a no-responder call to name manager availability
only, while a typed publish refusal names the capability only.
BUILD FIRST, REBUILD ON RESTORE: connector-core imports @cotal-ai/core through dist, so source
mutations are invisible there until core is rebuilt.

mutations.name: epCall stops watching the status stream, so a broker refusal becomes a false unanswered deadline again
mutations.find: const msg = await Promise.race([outcome, timeout, denied]);
mutations.expectRed: a broker-denied inspect reports permission-denied, not a false unanswered deadline
mutations.cell: a broker-denied inspect reports permission-denied, not a false unanswered deadline
mutations.note: The shipped failure shape from #904: nc.publish returned, the asynchronous publish violation was ignored, and the caller waited to deadline with EP_UNANSWERED. The real broker cell turns that exact regression red.

mutations.name: the connector again tells an unanswered caller that a capability denial may have happened
mutations.find: ? `${e.message} (no responder answered - the manager may be down or unreachable)`
mutations.replace: ? `${e.message} (no responder answered - a manager may be down, or this credential holds no "${command}" capability and the broker denied the request)`
mutations.expectRed: names manager availability only, never a broker refusal
mutations.cell: ...and names manager availability only, never a broker refusal the caller can distinguish
mutations.note: Once core distinguishes the transport facts, retaining the old ambiguous sentence is confidently wrong. This mutation restores the exact collapsed guidance and the rendering assertion catches it.
mutations.completionMarker: the verdict comes from the marker, not the code:
